name: Soul Exemplar (Soulforge Archetype)
body:
Rather than wielding armaments pulled from the akashic record, these rare warriors and historians focus entirely on aligning themselves with the souls of ancient heroes and villains, drawing forth even greater power than their more martially-focused kin.

Limited Veilweaving

The soul exemplar does not gain the ability to shape veils from the soulforge veil list, and does not gain the ability to shape veils at 1st, 6th, 12th, and 18th level. The soul exemplar only gains 1 point of essence at 1st level, and every 2 levels thereafter.

This modifies the soulforge’s veilweaving class feature.

Intuitive Knowledge

At 1st level, the soul exemplar’s forged souls influence their thoughts and knowledge, granting them intuitive understanding of numerous topics. The soul exemplar uses the higher of their Wisdom or their Intelligence modifiers when determining their bonus with Knowledge skills.

This replaces the soulforge’s intuitive crafter class feature.

Exemplified Soul Forging

The soul exemplar gains the ability to shape an additional soul veil each day at 1st, 6th, 12th, and 18th level.

This modifies the soulforge’s soul forging class feature.

Shifting Soul

The soul exemplar’s mastery over drawing forth the power of souls allows them flexibility with the powers they call upon. At 2nd level, as a move action that provokes attacks of opportunity, the soul exemplar can unshape one of their soul veils and instantly shape a new soul veil in its place. This veil cannot be bound to a chakra until the soul exemplar spends 1 hour in meditation. The soul exemplar can use this ability once per day, 3rd, 8th, 13th, and 18th level. At each of these levels, they may unshape and shape an additional soul veil as well (up to two at 3rd level, up to three at 8th level, and so on).

This replaces the soulforge’s soulforged armaments, twin soul, and rapid enhancement class features.

Soul Capacity

The soul exemplar’s improvements to the connection between their soul and the akashic record has improved their ability to utilize their essence. At 3rd level, 9th level, and 15th level, the maximum capacity of their forged souls increases by +1.

This replaces the soulforge’s forge capacity class feature.

Twin Soul

At 5th level, the soul exemplar may forge a second soul each day. For the purposes of this soul, their class level is treated as 4 levels lower when determining the abilities that soul grants them, and they gain only 1 temporary skill point per class level to assign to the second forged soul’s associated skills.

This soul counts as a second essence receptacle, affecting only the veils associated with the soul. This ability does not grant the soul exemplar additional associated veils shaped each day, but they may shape veils associated with either of their forged souls using their soul veil slots. If a veil the soul exemplar has shaped is associated with both of their forged souls, they use the soul with the higher number of points of invested essence when determining its effective essence investment.

At 10th level, the soul exemplar treats their class level as only 2 levels lower when determining the effects of their second soul. At 15th level, they no longer suffer a penalty to their class level with their second soul.

This replaces the soulforge’s soul enhancement class feature.

Improved Shifting Soul

At 10th level, when the soul exemplar shapes a veil using their shifting soul ability they may immediately bind it to its chakra slot if they have the ability to bind the shaped veil to its associated chakra.

Twinveil Soul

At 12th level, the soul exemplar can choose to shape and bind their soul veils in the same slot as another soul veil. The soul exemplar can only have their soul veils share the same slot using this ability, and it does not stack with similar effects, such as the Twin Veil feat. If the soul exemplar already had the Twin Veil feat, they may retrain it upon gaining this ability.

This replaces the soulforge’s twinveil forge class feature.

Masterful Shifting Soul

At 17th level, the soul exemplar can spend one hour in meditation and spend one use of their shifting soul ability to immediately change one of their forged souls for another, unshaping any soul veils associated with that soul in the process and shaping new soul veils in its place. The soul exemplar may immediately bind any veils they shape during this process, if they have the ability to.

This replaces the soulforge’s immortal soul forging class feature.
